quality: Automatic at preview; unresolved in the supplied files

patches.name: Worn Cassette
patches.description: Warm console saturation, mechanical tape wow/flutter, short tape echoes and cassette degradation.
patches.input: Drums, acoustic guitar, keys or full mixes.
patches.tweak: Raise Cassette Drift for more tape warble; raise Vibrato Amount for deeper pitch wow.

patches.name: Radio Static
patches.description: Hot input drive, mu-law digital crushing and heavy vari-mu pumping compression.
patches.input: Breaks, synth riffs, basslines and voice samples.
patches.tweak: Adjust Interference Macro to shift the aliasing carrier; raise Squash Amount for more aggressive pump.

patches.name: Metallic Chimes
patches.description: Inharmonic frequency shifting feeding a tuned acoustic Karplus resonator chord bank and diffuse chamber.
patches.input: Plucks, percussion, one-shots, bells or single notes. Halo root defaults to A2.
patches.tweak: Halo Macro changes the root chord pitch; Shift Macro shifts metallic sideband overtones.

patches.name: Kinetic Stutter
patches.description: Slow sweeping comb filter notches chopped by a synced rhythmic gate and bouncing polyrhythmic delay.
patches.input: Sustained pads, drones, basslines or ambient guitars.
patches.tweak: Tremolo Sync changes the chop rate; Cascade Sync sets the delay polyrhythm.

patches.name: Abyssal Drone
patches.description: Pitch-dropped octave sub-harmonics, dynamic slow swell, and an expansive pitch-regenerating shimmer wash.
patches.input: Dry hits, isolated plucks, stabs or sparse vocal fragments.
patches.tweak: Pitch Amount balances the deep sub rumble; Bloom Amount controls the ambient wash duration.

patches.name: Acid Screamer
patches.description: Vocal formant filter-fuzz growl pushed into aggressive West Coast wavefolding and resonant filtering.
patches.input: Synth leads, acid sequences, drum breaks and bass.
patches.tweak: Howl Macro sweeps the formant throat; Filter Amount sweeps low-pass (<50) or high-pass (>50).

patches.name: Glitch Collage
patches.description: Stereo micro-detuning feeding an asynchronous granular cloud with randomized pitch and backward delay fragments.
patches.input: Vocal phrases, acoustic instruments, percussion or field recordings.
patches.tweak: Collage Drift controls grain unpredictability; Reverse Delay Macro adjusts reversed slice length.

patches.name: Motor Breakdown
patches.description: Erratic motor drag, tape chewing dropouts, sputtering vintage transistor fuzz and cassette wear.
patches.input: Melodic loops, chords, drum grooves or bass riffs.
patches.tweak: Broken Amount sets the stall severity; Fuzz Amount dials in the sputtering transistor grit.

patches.name: Vaporwave VHS
patches.description: Lush stereo chorus detuning, analog tape wow, warm reel-to-reel slapback and exciter presence.
patches.input: Synth pads, electric pianos, Rhodes, polyphonic synth stabs.
patches.tweak: Raise Vibrato Drift for warped tape tracking; adjust Reels Macro for tape warmth.

patches.name: Resonant Formant
patches.description: Vocal vowel formant peaks driving resonant filtering and heavy companding punch.
patches.input: Sustained synth leads, wavetable sweeps, basslines and organ chords.
patches.tweak: Howl Macro sweeps vowel formants; Filter Macro shapes the resonant frequency cutoff.

patches.name: Sub Weight
patches.description: Sub-octave harmonic generation, warm preamp overdrive and steep low-pass contouring.
patches.input: Synth bass, thin sample plucks, kick drums and mono synth leads.
patches.tweak: Pitch Amount balances the sub-octave rumble; Drive Amount adjusts harmonic thickness.

patches.name: Crystalline Halo
patches.description: Tuned Karplus physical resonator chord bank, delicate frequency-shifted detuning and shimmering bloom.
patches.input: Bell synths, electric piano, ambient chords and sparse plucks.
patches.tweak: Halo Macro alters the resonator chord root; Bloom Macro controls high-frequency shimmer decay.

patches.name: Digital Rust
patches.description: Aggressive mu-law downsampling and aliasing, West Coast wavefolding and degraded cassette grit.
patches.input: Drum breaks, digital synths, industrial bass and gritty sample hits.
patches.tweak: Interference Macro alters aliasing bit-depth; Fold Amount introduces jagged folded overtones.

patches.name: Spectral Shiver
patches.description: Slow sweeping comb filter notches, eerie inharmonic frequency shifting and a vast reverberant space.
patches.input: Synth strings, choir pads, drone textures and atmospheric soundscapes.
patches.tweak: Phaser Sync alters sweep cycles; Shift Macro introduces ghostly bell-like dissonances.

patches.name: Ambient Bloom Swell
patches.description: Gradual envelope auto-swell, expansive chamber reflections and a rich pitch-shifted bloom shimmer.
patches.input: Percussive clicks, guitar plucks, piano chords and short synth arps.
patches.tweak: Swell Amount adjusts the attack swell rise; Bloom Tail sets the ambient decay duration.

patches.name: Sputter Drone
patches.description: Velcro transistor fuzz, mechanical motor dropouts and deep cavernous reverberation.
patches.input: Analog saw waves, heavy basslines, distorted beats and noise loops.
patches.tweak: Fuzz Amount increases sputtering saturation; Broken Drift randomizes dropout stutter rate.

patches.name: Tape Chorus Echo
patches.description: Wide stereo double-tracking, pitch-drifted tape vibrato and synchronized multi-tap delay bounces.
patches.input: Synth brass, lead synths, arpeggios, electric guitars and vocal tracks.
patches.tweak: Doubler Macro alters stereo spread; Cascade Sync sets delay division to the project tempo.

patches.name: Overfolded Drive
patches.description: Hot analog overdrive pushing into Buchla-style asymmetric wavefolding and high-frequency exciter air.
patches.input: Sine/triangle synth leads, Rhodes chords, 808 subs and acoustic drums.
patches.tweak: Drive Amount controls input breakup; Fold Amount dials in rich wavefolded overtones.

patches.name: Granular Warp
patches.description: Detuned micro-pitch shifting feeding a randomized granular particle cloud and reversed temporal slices.
patches.input: Vocal samples, acoustic instruments, ambient pads and melodic synth lines.
patches.tweak: Collage Drift varies grain dispersion; Reverse Delay Sync sets the backward loop division.

patches.name: Pumping Noise Floor
patches.description: Cassette RF interference and aliasing grit compressed by an aggressive pumping vari-mu compressor into vintage tape reels.
patches.input: Drum grooves, synth plucks, basslines and minimal percussive sequences.
patches.tweak: Squash Amount sets the compression pump depth; Interference Amount adjusts background noise texture.
